name: Allen Wu
office: City of Walnut, Member of the City Council

items.text: Allen Wu has served on the Walnut City Council since 2018, and was selected as mayor in 2022 and again in 2026. He previously was a director of the Walnut Valley Water District and a parks and recreation commissioner. He holds a Ph.D. in civil engineering and master’s degrees in public administration and environmental engineering from USC.

sentences.text: Allen Wu has served on the Walnut City Council since 2018, and was selected as mayor in 2022 and again in 2026.
He previously was a director of the Walnut Valley Water District and a parks and recreation commissioner.
He holds a Ph.D. in civil engineering and master’s degrees in public administration and environmental engineering from USC.

items.text: In 2026, he said his top priorities are public safety, road and park improvements, and keeping the city’s finances sound. He added that during his prior term as mayor the city improved public safety and secured state and federal grants for infrastructure. He also notes the city budget has been in surplus.
